fields.permitted_stay: Up to 30 days per entry, counted from the day after entry; multiple entries allowed. Policy in force until 31 December 2026.
fields.application_channel_detail: Eligible ordinary-passport visitors do not need to make advance visa-waiver declarations to Chinese embassies or consulates. Border examination and approval still apply.
exceptions: Ordinary passports only: holders of temporary, emergency or other travel documents still need a visa
Work, study and news coverage are not covered; a visa is required for those purposes
The policy runs until 31 December 2026; check before travelling after that date
Stay is counted from 00:00 on the day after entry; there is no cap on the number of entries
fields.passport_validity: Ordinary passport valid for at least the entire intended stay in China.
required_documents: Ordinary passport valid for the entire intended stay
Invitation letters, air tickets and accommodation reservations are recommended as evidence of the purpose of entry
fields.entry_requirements: Use an ordinary passport valid for the entire intended stay. Admission is subject to examination and approval by Chinese border inspection authorities. The visa waiver covers tourism; it does not cover work, study or news coverage. Supporting invitation letters, air tickets and accommodation reservations are recommended.

disposition.note: China's unilateral visa-free policy, verified 2026-08-22 against the MFA consular FAQ, the NIA country list (2026-02-17) and embassy notices: 50 countries, up to 30 days per entry (raised from 15 on 30 Nov 2024), for business, tourism, family or friends visits, exchange and transit; in force until 31 December 2026. Ordinary passports only; work, study and news coverage are excluded.
